Beer Incentive Delay task

description.value: Participants saw cues predicting beer or water, responded rapidly to a visual target, and received the predicted drink when successful.

spans.text: participants first saw a cue informing them about the opportunity to earn beer (yellow triangle) or water (blue square), followed by a variable delay materialized by a fixation cross.
beer

description.value: Beer condition: participants saw a yellow triangle predicting the opportunity to earn a 3 mL sip of beer, waited through a variable fixation delay, and had to respond quickly to the visual target with a button press. Successful responses produced a green tick followed by beer delivery through a tube into the mouth and swallowing; unsuccessful responses produced a red cross and no drink. There were 30 pseudo-randomized beer trials.

spans.text: in which the rewards were 3 mL sips of either beer or water
water

description.value: Water control condition: participants saw a blue square predicting the opportunity to earn a 3 mL sip of water, waited through a variable fixation delay, and had to respond quickly to the visual target with a button press. Successful responses produced a green tick followed by water delivery through a tube into the mouth and swallowing; unsuccessful responses produced a red cross and no drink. There were 30 pseudo-randomized water trials.

spans.text: in which the rewards were 3 mL sips of either beer or water
using a button press

instructions.value: Participants were instructed to respond as fast as possible to a visual target using a button press. If the response was fast enough, they received the predicted drink; if too slow, the trial ended.

spans.text: participants were instructed to respond to it as fast as possible using a button press.

stimuli.value: Abstract beer- and water-predicting cues (yellow triangle and blue square), a fixation cross during a variable delay, a visual target, and feedback in the form of a green tick for successful responses or a red cross for unsuccessful responses.
